exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials permitted. BABOK Guide v3 is the primary reference for exam content. 30-day waiting period required before retaking.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match IIBA registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: "The CBAP exam is 210 minutes long and consists of 120 case-study and scenario-based multiple-choice questions."

official_study_resources.notes: Primary reference for all IIBA certification exams
official_study_resources.title: BABOK Guide v3 (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge)

official_study_resources.notes: Official practice questions and study resources
official_study_resources.title: IIBA Exam Prep Resources

prerequisites.description: Minimum 5 years (7,500 hours) of BA work experience in the last 10 years
35 hours of professional development in the last 4 years
Two references from a career manager or CBAP recipient

renewal_options: Earn 60 CDUs (Continuing Development Units) every 3 years. CDUs earned through professional development, education, volunteering, and BA activities. Submit CDUs via the IIBA certification portal.

retake_policy.notes: Must wait 30 days before retaking. Full exam fee required for each retake attempt.

testing_centers.notes: PSI test centers and online proctored delivery
